description: The gate as a device: a threshold, a floor, an attack, a hold, a release and a look-ahead, its models (clean, with a sidechain, or the hysteresis gate of @audio/dynamics-gate), the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the detector worklet, the source of the hysteresis model's worklet and the curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
name: gate-device
